user.title: Connect this Home Assistant to Simson
user.description: Keep the default when the Simson add-on runs on this Home Assistant. Enter a different local API URL only when the add-on is hosted elsewhere on your network.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Simson add-on. Check that it is running, then confirm the local API URL.

abort.already_configured: This Home Assistant is already connected to Simson.
abort.addon_not_ready: The Simson add-on is still starting. Wait a moment, then try again.

user_notifications.title: People and phone mappings
user_notifications.description: Choose a user. The saved phone mapping belongs to their Simson contact and works with cards, buttons and scripts.

notification_phone.title: Call notification phone
notification_phone.description: Choose the Companion device for this user. This is stored centrally, independently of dashboards. The phone must be signed in as the recipient to answer. Save before testing; if the test fails, the mapping is still saved.

data.send_test: Save and send a test notification

connection.title: Add-on connection
connection.description: Change only when the add-on API address changes.

error.phone_unavailable: This phone notify service is unavailable. Choose a registered Companion phone.
error.notification_failed: Could not finish saving or testing. Check the phone mapping and notification permissions, then retry.

abort.contacts_unavailable: No Simson user contacts are loaded for this entry. Check the integration connection and enabled Home Assistant users.
